_how_to_use: Each clip in queue/ must name a campaign key from this file (in its .json sidecar, field 'campaign'). Clips with no valid, active campaign are NOT posted. Add one entry per Whop/Vyro campaign you join. 'organic' is only for content you own or have explicit permission to post.

organic.name: Organic (no paid campaign)
organic.notes: Only for content you own or have explicit permission to post. No #ad.

example-whop-campaign.name: Example: Whop campaign name
example-whop-campaign.notes: Copy the campaign's rules here (required sound, tags, banned edits). Set active to true once you've joined.

boxabl.name: Boxabl Official Clipping (Clip Farm, Whop Content Rewards)
boxabl.submit_where: contentrewards.com -> Boxabl Official Clipping -> Submit clip
caption_rules: Tag @boxabl in every caption (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube).
Caption must be about Boxabl: the Casita, foldable homes, or the factory.
Spell the brand BOXABL correctly (all caps is fine).
Positive tone toward Boxabl, its product and featured talent.
Never mention Boxabl stock, shares, investing in Boxabl, or any ticker symbol.
No engagement bait, no politics or controversy.
clip_rules: Only Boxabl-approved footage (sources.json). Never use clips of Kanye.
Show the whole Boxabl home at some point, not only close-up details.
Brand must be clear: the on-screen hook title must contain the word BOXABL (or Boxabl must be said in the clip).
Hook in the first 2 seconds; bold captions for muted viewing (ClipKit adds these).
Real edits only (captions, cuts, hooks) - never a raw rip. Vary moments; never repeat the same moment.
Positive moments only: the unfolding, the space, the price/value wow, the factory scale, celebrity reactions.
No other brands' watermarks; avoid moments dominated by another brand's logo or sponsor read.
boxabl.payment_notes: Pays only if at least 40% of the clip's audience is US/UK/CA/AUS. 'Share audience demographics' is required when submitting. Up to $500 per clip.
boxabl.notes: Optional: Boxabl affiliate program at boxabl.com/affiliate.
